verified.note: Record row (best variational bound; ED holds the instance record, 0.00034 below). 4 x 4 torus, 5 + 5, grid U = 2.15443469, N~ = 10 and alpha = 64 (main Fig. 3 caption B: 'n = 5/8 average site occupancy (first closed shell) and N~ = 10. Projection: 'Projections to different symmetry subspaces are applied to the converged trial state: rotation of π/2 (C4), translations of momentum K = 0 and the intersection of both subspaces' (SI Sec. 8 B); the stored row is the intersection, as the method string says. A projected state's energy is at least its sector's minimum and so still an upper bound on the ground state: variational is right. Stored sigma equals the printed bar. Venue PNAS, peer reviewed ('Edited by Angel Rubio ... received December 6, 2021; accepted June 28, 2022'; 'This article is a PNAS Direct Submission'); the imported row carries no peer_reviewed field (loader-level, see report). No duplicate.
